key_sub: We help at home and care for each other.
body_html:
How to think about it

A family can be big or small. In a joint family, grandparents, parents, uncles, aunts and cousins live together; in a nuclear family, parents and children live together. We call our father's or mother's mother 'grandmother' and their brothers 'uncles'.

Family members share the work at home and care for each other. Good friends are kind, share and help. We care for pets with food, water and love, and we never go with strangers.

Example

Who is your mother's brother?

your parent's brother

Answer: your uncle

Example

Parents and two children in one home?

a small family

Answer: a nuclear family

Common mistakes

  • Calling a cousin a brother.
  • Thinking only big families are real families.
  • Going with a stranger who offers sweets.
